name: JELI (Enhanced Library Images)
description: JELI generates stunning perspective poster-wall splash screens for your Jellyfin libraries. Choose from 6 perspective modes (diagonal, floor, ceiling, barrel, flat), add custom overlay images and text layers, upload custom fonts, and schedule automatic regeneration. Built by Synthmania.
overview: Generate perspective poster-wall splash screens for your Jellyfin libraries.

versions.changelog: Public release. Six perspective modes (↖ Diagonal, ↗ Diagonal, ⬆ Floor, ⬇ Ceiling, ⊙ Barrel, ▦ Flat Wall). Six image source modes. Per-library overlay images and text layers. Two bundled fonts (Pasajero, Candy Kisses). Four default gradient overlays. Auto-scheduling with live task updates. Generations manager tab. Resolution-aware live preview. Output console relocated below the preview panel.
